name: @qiyascc/clarity-overlay
description: Pins heatmaps, predicted clicks and review notes onto a live or replayed web page.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/global.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --minify --outfile=dist/clarity-overlay.iife.js && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
